verdict.rationale: Circle publishes machine-readable OpenAPI YAML files under developers.circle.com/openapi/, including compliance.yaml (address screening) and gateway.yaml (chain-abstracted USDC balances). The probe's 404s only cover generic root paths like /openapi.json, so they do not contradict the per-product specs. Missing for 10: evidence that specs cover all products (Wallets, CCTP, CPN), a single discoverable index or download link for the specs, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the specs are complete and usable.
